description: This donut chart illustrates the distribution of a category labeled "Task Type," which is written in bold text within the center hole of the chart. The chart is divided into a total of two slices. The significantly larger slice, colored light red, represents "Article generation" and accounts for 83.2% of the total. The smaller slice, colored light yellow, represents "Headline generation" at 16.8%. There is no separate legend included; instead, the category labels and their corresponding exact percentages are positioned directly outside their respective segments. Neither slice is visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting, and the segments are visually ordered by size, with the larger light red segment dominating the majority of the ring.
